_comment: Machining calculators — the ONE definition of every machining cycle-time formula. scripts/generate-machining-calculators-migration.mjs writes these into the calculators / calculator_fields / process_calculator_mappings tables; the cost engine evaluates the stored formulas (calculator-formula-evaluator.ts) with CAD + lookup-table inputs; tests load this file as the stand-in for those rows. Edit here and regenerate — never hand-edit the migration. Every calculator's output is 'Cycle Time' in seconds. Input 'source': cad | lookup | machine | bom | drawing | engine | default (a database default with no reference source — shown as such in the trace).

stations.2_axis_bar_feed_lathe_with_sub_spindle: 2 Axis Bar Feed Lathe with Sub Spindle
stations.3_axis_bar_feed_lathe_with_sub_spindle: 3 Axis Bar Feed Lathe with Sub Spindle

calculators.name: Machining - Drilling
calculators.description: Drilled-hole cycle time: CAD hole diameter and depth, cutting speed and feed from tblDrilling for the material and drill construction.

calculators.name: Machining - Rough Turning
calculators.description: Rough turning passes over the turned length: CAD turned diameter/length, stock bar diameter, depth of cut / speed / feed from tblGeneralTurning.

fields.name: Rough Stock
fields.formula: max({Radial Stock} - min({Finish Depth of Cut}, {Radial Stock}), 0)

calculators.name: Machining - Finish Turning
calculators.description: One finish turning pass over the turned length: CAD turned diameter/length, finish speed and feed from tblGeneralTurning.

calculators.name: Machining - Parting
calculators.description: Part-off plunge from the bar surface to its centre: stock bar diameter, insert speed and feed from tblVirtualPartoffInsertCutData.

calculators.name: Machining - Reaming
calculators.description: Reaming pass through the drilled hole: CAD hole diameter and depth, speed and feed from tblReaming.

calculators.name: Machining - Rigid Tapping
calculators.description: Rigid tapping of a threaded hole: CAD thread diameter, depth and pitch (the part, else the ISO 261 coarse pitch of its nominal size), cutting speed from tblTapping for the material and pitch. The tap feeds one pitch per revolution in and reverses out at the same feed.

calculators.name: Machining - Jig Boring
calculators.description: Jig boring: finish-boring physics from tblBoringV2 repeated the number of passes tblGtolProcessCapabilities gives for jig boring.

calculators.name: Machining - Gun Drilling
calculators.description: Deep-hole gun drilling: CAD hole diameter and depth, speed and feed from tblGunDrilling.

calculators.name: Machining - Deep Bore
calculators.description: Deep-hole boring: CAD hole diameter and depth, speed and feed from the deep bore drill lookup.

calculators.name: Machining - Cylindrical Grinding
calculators.description: Traverse grinding of a turned OD: CAD diameter/length, grinding allowance (variables finishGrindingDepth), wheel/work data from tblCylindricalGrinding.

calculators.name: Machining - Internal Grinding
calculators.description: Traverse grinding of a bore: CAD bore diameter/depth, grinding allowance (variables finishGrindingDepth), wheel/work data from tblInternalGrinding.

calculators.name: Machining - Jig Grind
calculators.description: Jig grinding of a hardened bore: traverse bore-grinding values (tblInternalGrinding; memory/ has no jig-grinding table) repeated the number of passes tblGtolProcessCapabilities gives for jig grinding.

calculators.name: Machining - Surface Grinding
calculators.description: Traverse surface grinding of a flat face on a reciprocating grinder: CAD face length and width, grinding allowance (variables finishGrindingDepth), table speed, down-feeds and crossfeed from tblReciprocatingSurfaceGrinding (crossfeed capped at its fraction of the tblGrinding wheel width). Each pass strokes the face length once per crossfeed step across its width.

calculators.name: Machining - Keyway Broaching
calculators.description: Keyway broaching with the reference broach for the keyway width and length: a pull-type broach (single pass) when one fits, else a shim-type broach (one pass per shim plus the first). Each pass strokes the broach (teeth x pitch) plus the keyway length at the broach cutting speed; the broach is repositioned between passes (variables).

calculators.name: Machining - Wire EDM
calculators.description: One roughing and one finishing wire pass over the CAD cut path, feed rates from tblWireEDMing.

calculators.name: Machining - Deburring
calculators.description: Deburring every sharp edge: CAD sharp-edge length (seams and tangent edges excluded) at the tblDeburring edge speed for the material.

calculators.name: Machining - Index Transfer
calculators.description: Multi-spindle index cycle per part: drum index, transfer, stock feed and speed synchronisation times from the machine record.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Drum Index Time} + {Transfer Time} + {Stock Feed Time} + {Speed Synchronization Time}

calculators.name: Machining - Secondary Setup
calculators.description: A second chucking for features a 2-axis lathe cannot reach in one setup: workholder install-and-remove time from tblInstallingTurningWorkholders, spread over the batch.

calculators.name: Machining - Inspection
calculators.description: Inspection time per part: per-piece measurement (allowances are database defaults — no reference source maps features to tblInspection analyses), spread over first-article / in-process / final sampling.

fields.name: Tight Tolerance Time
fields.formula: IF({Tightest Tolerance} > 0 and {Tightest Tolerance} <= {Tight Tolerance Threshold}, {Tight Tolerance CMM Time}, 0)

fields.name: Inspection per Piece
fields.formula: {Positioning Time} + {Holes Sampled} * {Time per Sampled Hole} + {Threads Checked} * {Time per Thread Gauge} + {Tight Tolerance Time} + {GDT Time}

fields.name: In-process Pieces
fields.formula: floor(max({Batch Size} - {First Article Pieces}, 0) / {In-process 1 in N})

fields.name: Measured Minutes per Batch
fields.formula: {Inspection per Piece} * ({First Article Pieces} + {In-process Pieces}) + {Final Check Time} * {Final Check Pieces}

calculators.name: Machining - Inspection
calculators.description: Inspection time per part from memory/Machining: one analysis of the default inspection type (variables defaultInspectionType, its time from tblInspection) on the share of parts inspected (variables defaultInspectionSampleRatio), plus every part's final quality inspection (variables defaultFinalInspectionTime, min). The holes inspected (Special Inspection: Feature Inspection of SimpleHole, MultiStepHole, RingedHole) are listed on the line; the reference does not make the time per hole, so one analysis is one inspected part.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Time Per Analysis} * {Inspection Sample Ratio} + {Final Inspection Time} * 60

calculators.name: Machining - Hobbing
calculators.description: Hobbing a gear: CAD teeth, face width, module (tip diameter / (teeth + 2)) and tooth depth ((tip - root) / 2); ANSI hob diameter and starts (tblAnsiHobbing, variables defaultNumStarts); cutting speed and axial feed (tblHobbing). The hob travels the face width plus its approach (the chord of a hob of that diameter entering the tooth depth); the gear turns teeth / starts revolutions per hob revolution.

calculators.name: Machining - Shaving
calculators.description: Gear shaving after hobbing: CAD teeth, module and face width; strokes, cutting speed and feed per workpiece revolution from tblShaving; workpiece speed capped at variables maxShavingWorkpieceSpeed. Each stroke traverses the face width.

calculators.name: Machining - Rotary Broaching
calculators.description: Rotary broaching a polygon socket (drawing polygon callout + CAD polygon ring): depth from CAD; RPM and feed from tblRotaryBroaching (depth within the broach reach), feed calibrated by variables rotaryBroachFeedAdjustment. The pilot hole is priced by the Drilling calculator.

calculators.name: Machining - Milling
calculators.description: The milling line of a part on a mill or a live-tool turning machine: the time of every catalog operation the machine performs on the part's CAD features (operation-sequencer.ts), by operation group, plus the allowance for rapid moves and tool changes between them.

fields.name: Cutting Time
fields.formula: {Facing Time} + {Rough Milling Time} + {Finish Milling Time} + {Contouring Time} + {Slot and Groove Milling Time} + {Hole Making Time} + {Edge Treatment Time} + {Other Operations Time}

calculators.name: Machining - Rotary Surface Grinding
calculators.description: Rotary-table surface grinding: the wheel covers the face, so each table revolution is one pass. Rough passes take the allowance down to the finish stock, one finish pass removes it, and spark-out is the reference multiple of the finish time (variables sparkOutMultiplier). Speeds and downfeeds from tblRotarySurfaceGrinding for the material.

calculators.name: Machining - Straight Bevel Gear Cutting
calculators.description: Straight bevel gear cutting: every tooth space is cut across the face width by a cutter the size of the pitch diameter (straightBevelCutterDiameterToPitchDiameterRatio), at the tblStraightBevelGearCutting cutting speed, feed per tooth and blades per side for the material and that cutter diameter.

calculators.name: Machining - Spiral Bevel Gear Cutting
calculators.description: Spiral bevel gear cutting: every tooth space is cut across the face width by a cutter the size of the pitch diameter (spiralBevelCutterDiameterToPitchDiameterRatio), at the tblSpiralBevelGearCutting cutting speed, feed per tooth and blades per side for the material and that cutter diameter.

calculators.name: Machining - Shaping
calculators.description: Gear shaping: the cutter is fed radially to tooth depth, generates the teeth in one roughing revolution, then one finishing revolution. tblShaping gives three cut types per material with no legend; type 1 (the lowest stroke rate) is read as roughing and type 3 (the finest rotary feed) as finishing. Each stroke adds the reference dwells (variables shapingDwellTimePerStroke, numDwellsPerShapingStroke).

fields.name: Rough Strokes
fields.formula: {Tooth Depth} / {Radial Feed} + pi * {Pitch Diameter} / {Rough Rotary Feed}

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Rough Strokes} * (60 / {Rough Stroke Rate} + {Dwell per Stroke}) + {Finish Strokes} * (60 / {Finish Stroke Rate} + {Dwell per Stroke})

calculators.name: Machining - Automated Deburring
calculators.description: Automated deburring of every sharp edge: CAD sharp-edge length at the tblDeburring edge speed of the reference default edge tool for the material.

calculators.name: Machining - Drill Press
calculators.description: Drilling on a drill press: CAD hole diameter and depth, cutting speed and feed from tblDrilling for the material and drill construction.

calculators.name: Machining - Stock Prep Mill
calculators.description: Preparing the stock on a mill before the part is machined: the time of each milling operation group on the stock, plus the allowance for rapid moves and tool changes.

calculators.name: Machining - Stock Prep Lathe
calculators.description: Preparing the stock on a lathe before the part is machined: rough turning of the bar to the stock diameter, cutting data from tblGeneralTurning for the material.

calculators.name: Machining - Bench Operation
calculators.description: Bench work on a machined part: identing and the spark test, each at its reference time (variables defaultIdentingTime, in seconds, and defaultSparkTestTime, in minutes).

calculators.name: Machining - Routering
calculators.description: Routering a profile: the cut length taken in passes of the depth one pass removes. The reference holds no router feed table, so the feed rate and the depth per pass are entered for the material and cutter in use.

calculators.name: Machining - Facing
calculators.description: Facing the stock square before any feature is cut: one facing pass per part.

calculators.name: Machining - Rough Milling
calculators.description: Milling a feature's volume out (a pocket, a slot, a milled keyway): the CAD removed volume at the material removal rate of the material, most of it roughed and the rest taken at the slower finishing rate.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Removed Volume} * {Roughing Share} / {Material Removal Rate} + {Removed Volume} * (1 - {Roughing Share}) / ({Material Removal Rate} * {Finishing Rate Factor})) * 60

calculators.name: Machining - Bulk Milling
calculators.description: Milling away the volume of a feature that has no operation of its own: the same removal model as rough milling.

calculators.name: Machining - Fine Finish Milling
calculators.description: Finishing milled surfaces: a planar face's CAD area taken to the finish depth at the material removal rate, and each pocket's floor and wall finishing passes.

fields.name: Area Time
fields.formula: ({Finish Volume} * {Roughing Share} / {Material Removal Rate} + {Finish Volume} * (1 - {Roughing Share}) / ({Material Removal Rate} * {Finishing Rate Factor})) * 60

calculators.name: Machining - Contouring
calculators.description: Contouring curved walls and surfaces: their CAD area taken to the finish depth at the material removal rate.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Finish Volume} * {Roughing Share} / {Material Removal Rate} + {Finish Volume} * (1 - {Roughing Share}) / ({Material Removal Rate} * {Finishing Rate Factor})) * 60

calculators.name: Machining - Perimeter Milling
calculators.description: Milling the wall of a through cutout: its CAD wall area, by the contouring model.

calculators.name: Machining - Slot Milling
calculators.description: The finishing pass of each slot after it is roughed.

calculators.name: Machining - Center Drilling
calculators.description: Spotting each hole before it is drilled.

calculators.name: Machining - Chamfering
calculators.description: Chamfering edges: the edge length at the tblChamfering edge speed for the material; an edge with no CAD size takes a set time.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Edge Length} / {Edge Speed} + {Unsized Edges} * {Time per Unsized Edge}

calculators.name: Machining - Filleting
calculators.description: Rounding edges: the edge length at the tblCornerRoundingMill edge speed for the material; an edge with no CAD size takes a set time.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Edge Length} / {Edge Speed} + {Unsized Edges} * {Time per Unsized Edge}

calculators.name: Machining - Groove Milling
calculators.description: Milling grooves: the groove length at the tblCornerRoundingMill edge speed for the material, by the filleting model.

calculators.name: Machining - Mask Cure
calculators.description: Curing the maskant before chemical milling: the cure time of the maskant in this oven (tblMaskingMaterials gives 8 h unheated and 1 h heated), shared by the parts one oven load holds.

calculators.name: Machining - Scribe
calculators.description: Scribing the maskant around each pocket to be etched: the outline of the pockets at the scribe's feed rate.

calculators.name: Machining - Etch Cell
calculators.description: Chemical milling in the etch tank: the pocket depth at the tblChemicalMillingEtchingRates rate for the material, then rinsing, desmut, desmut rinse and drying at their reference times, shared by the parts one load holds; then peeling the pocket maskant at the tblChemicalMilling rate.

fields.name: Tank Time
fields.formula: {Etching Time} + {Rinsing Time} + {Desmut Time} + {Desmut Rinse Time} + {Drying Time}

calculators.name: Machining - DeMask
calculators.description: Removing the maskant after etching: peeling the whole part at the tblChemicalMilling rate, capped at the reference time (variables demaskPeelTimeUpperCap), then dressing the pocket edges by hand (variables defaultEdgeDressingRate).

fields.name: Peeling Time
fields.formula: min({Part Surface Area} / {Peel Rate}, {Peel Time Cap} * 60)

calculators.name: Machining - Spline Rolling
calculators.description: Cold rolling a spline between racks: one rolling stroke per spline. The reference states which materials can be rolled (tblSplineRolling) and up to what module (variables splineRollingMaxModule) but holds no rolling time, so the stroke time of the machine is entered.

calculators.name: Machining - Profile Gear Grinding
calculators.description: Profile (form) grinding a gear one tooth gap at a time: the radial stock taken in strokes of the infeed, plus the finishing strokes, each stroke across the face width and its overtravel at the axial feed. The reference holds no gear-grinding table, so the grinding data of the wheel and machine are entered.

calculators.name: Machining - Threaded Wheel Gear Grinding
calculators.description: Continuous generating grinding with a threaded wheel: the gear turns one tooth per wheel start per wheel revolution while the wheel feeds across the face width, as a hob does. The reference holds no gear-grinding table, so the wheel and feed data are entered.
